_comment: ENV-008-AI production SLOs (ADR-087). Targets come from docs/operations/slo-definitions.md and must not be tuned to pass. Applied by .github/workflows/grafana-slos.yml with tools/scripts/observability/apply-grafana-slos.mjs. Windows are 28 days rolling (Grafana has no calendar window); the doc's 30-day calendar window, 3x/2h burn rule and 75%-budget rule are recorded gaps.

slos.name: api availability
slos.description: Share of api server requests (health probes excluded) that do not end in an error span. Target 99.9% over 28 days (slo-definitions.md L33). Not counted: tRPC failures that return 200 or 4xx, because they surface as INTERNAL spans, not server errors; and requests slower than 30 s that did not error.

annotations.value: api availability is burning its 28-day error budget fast
api availability is burning its 28-day error budget steadily

slos.name: api latency
slos.description: Share of api server requests (health probes excluded) that finish within 200 ms, from the native span-latency histogram. Target 95% over 28 days (slo-definitions.md L56, p95 < 200 ms). No burn-rate alerting yet: production p95 was 2.72 s on 2026-10-22, so the budget is already spent. Enable alerting when #1001 is fixed.

slos.name: ai-worker LLM success
slos.description: Share of ai-worker llm.invoke calls that do not end in an error span. Target 99.5% over 28 days (slo-definitions.md L116). Very low call volume (about 10 calls a week), so most evaluation steps have no data. No burn-rate alerting yet: every llm.invoke span failed in production on 2026-10-22. Enable alerting when #1029 is fixed.
